enforceEnabled.title: Keep protection on
enforceEnabled.description: When true, Veil cannot be turned off or paused from its own interface.

minimumStrictness.title: Minimum protection level
minimumStrictness.description: Protection level floor: minimal, balanced, strict or maximum.

strictBrowsing.title: Enforce Strict Browsing
strictBrowsing.description: Turns on Strict Browsing (SafeSearch, YouTube Restricted Mode, protected fallback).

revealMode.title: Reveal behaviour
revealMode.description: How protected media can be revealed: click, hold, hover or disabled.
